claims.text: Bayesian inference can be introduced during LLM generation to model uncertainty in the parameter space and avoid overconfident predictions.
Predictive distribution entropy measures the uncertainty level of generated summary content.
Joint optimization of entropy regularization and risk-aware loss explicitly expresses risk attributes while preserving key information during text compression.
Integrating risk scoring and regulation modules provides explicit risk-level prompts for summarization.

evidence.description: Bayesian inference is introduced during generation to model uncertainty in the parameter space, which helps avoid overconfident predictions.
The uncertainty level of the generated content is measured using predictive distribution entropy.
A joint optimization of entropy regularization and risk-aware loss is applied to ensure that key information is preserved and risk attributes are explicitly expressed during information compression.
The model incorporates risk scoring and regulation modules, allowing summaries to cover the core content accurately while enhancing trustworthiness through explicit risk-level prompts.

methodologies.name: Risk-Aware Bayesian LLM Summarization Framework
methodologies.description: A conditional text generation framework that incorporates parameter-space Bayesian uncertainty estimation via predictive entropy and joint entropy-regularized risk-aware loss optimization.

limitations.text: Standard generation-based summarization models risk making overconfident predictions in high-risk decision-making contexts.
